clips.title: The story
paras: In Dolanaar, Laurna Morninglight teaches young night elf priests the rites of Elune. Devoted to the Sisterhood of Elune, she guides acolytes from Shadowglen in healing and spiritual practice as threats gather in Teldrassil.

In Dolanaar, Laurna Morninglight guides young priests from Shadowglen. As new initiates travel farther into Teldrassil, she teaches them to deepen their bond with Elune. Her lessons join healing with defensive rites, skills needed in an increasingly hostile wild.

Among the kaldorei, priestcraft follows Elune, not the Holy Light revered by humans and dwarves. Laurna sends her students to receive sacred robes and heal a wounded Sentinel. Through these rites, acolytes learn that the Mother Moon grants their power to preserve and mend the kaldorei people.
